cohort.split_rule: Recompute protocol.metadata_split from authenticated participants.tsv with fixed GRADIENT-HELDOUT-v1 salt and require exact agreement; no alternate split.
cohort.holdout_claim: Procedural locked split of previously used public data, not pristine unseen participants.

include: Decode original20 BOLD and selected15 confounds in split-isolated processes
No-band-pass detrend and nuisance QR projection
Held-out eligibility on immutable discovery support
Denied opposite-partition reads and denied fit-artifact writes
exclude: changing the split, cleaning or activity rule
scientific_scope.spatial_limit: Inherited FSLMNI152/MNI152NLin6Asym atlas to MNI152NLin2009cAsym BOLD identity-world approximation; no nonlinear registration or anatomical qualification inferred.
scientific_scope.cleaning: Inherited no-band-pass branch only; exact-constant guards; detrend signal and15 nuisance columns; center/scale nuisance; pivoted economic QR absdiagR>100eps; residuals; no final zscoring.
scientific_scope.activity: centered residual L2 >1e-12*sqrt(168)*max(1,original raw sampleSD); no epsilon correlation repair and no outcome-based exclusions.
scientific_scope.fit_output: All ten person/parcel diagnostics, source hashes and discovery intersection support, no evaluation source values.
scientific_scope.evaluation_output: All ten person/parcel diagnostics and valid/invalid status on the unchanged discovery support; all people retained.

isolation.trusted_authentication_stage: Sees full baked source, authenticates bytes and public contracts, creates exact allowlist copies for two capsules; does not compute image signals.
isolation.fit_and_evaluate: Separate containers; original /app and /opt/source_capture covered by empty tmpfs. Mount only current partition capsule at/source readonly, approved code/public contracts readonly, stage output writable. Evaluation alone also receives frozen fit artifact readonly.
negative_probes: Open each opposite-partition BOLD/confounds path at/source must fail
Open opposite-partition original/app/data/gradient path must fail
Evaluation open-for-write of frozen fit artifact must fail

stop_conditions: Unexpected source role/member or metadata split
Nonfinite contributing source or nuisance values
Empty discovery support or missing represented network
Global time, memory or output limit
Any attempt to change scientific settings
evidence_scope: Source/support and process-isolation engineering pilot only, not anatomical validation, full source-backed verifier, oracle pass, scientific endpoint result or model difficulty.
